Areas: precincts, sub-precincts and site-specific controls

Source: R/overlays.R
area.Rd

An area is a mapped place with its own rules that replace the zone's (where an overlay usually only caps them). Sub-areas refine the area's rules for parts of it, keyed by an attribute of the area layer.

Usage

area(
  id,
  layer,
  filter = NULL,
  applies_to_zones = NULL,
  parameters = NULL,
  additions = NULL,
  zone_parameters = NULL,
  sub_area_field = NULL,
  sub_areas = NULL,
  max_dwellings = NULL,
  min_dwellings = NULL,
  max_floorspace = NULL,
  combine = "replace",
  label = NULL,
  source = NULL,
  notes = NULL
)

Arguments

id

Identifier.

layer

Name of the layer supplied at run time.

filter

Named list: attribute to accepted values.

applies_to_zones

Zone keys the area changes; NULL for all.

parameters

A zone_changes() applied to every zone in the area.

additions

A zone_changes() whose setbacks are added to the zone's own instead of replacing them.

zone_parameters

Named list of zone_changes(), by zone key, for changes that differ by zone.

sub_area_field

Attribute of the layer naming the sub-area.

sub_areas

Named list, by sub-area value, of zone_changes() or sub_area().

max_dwellings, min_dwellings, max_floorspace

Totals across the whole area (e.g. a precinct capped at 2,000 dwellings).

combine

"replace" (default) or "cap".

label, source, notes

Description and citation.

Value

A list with class plancap_area.

See also

add_area()

Examples

area("quarry", layer = "precincts",
     parameters = zone_changes(height = height_limit(16, source = "I1.6.1")),
     sub_area_field = "sub_precinct",
     sub_areas = list(B = zone_changes(height = height_limit(20, source = "I1.6.1(b)"))),
     source = "Quarry Precinct")
#> $layer
#> [1] "precincts"
#> 
#> $combine
#> [1] "replace"
#> 
#> $parameters
#> $parameters$height
#> $parameters$height$value
#> [1] 16
#> 
#> $parameters$height$source
#> [1] "I1.6.1"
#> 
#> 
#> 
#> $sub_area_field
#> [1] "sub_precinct"
#> 
#> $sub_areas
#> $sub_areas$B
#> $sub_areas$B$height
#> $sub_areas$B$height$value
#> [1] 20
#> 
#> $sub_areas$B$height$source
#> [1] "I1.6.1(b)"
#> 
#> 
#> 
#> 
#> $source
#> [1] "Quarry Precinct"
#> 
#> attr(,"id")
#> [1] "quarry"
#> attr(,"class")
#> [1] "plancap_area"
